name: onomeo-mcp
description: Ask free LLMs (DeepSeek, GLM, Gemini, Mistral and more) for a second opinion.
long_description: Lets your assistant ask other models through onomeo, an OpenAI-compatible API where a rotating set of models is free to call with no credit card. onomeo is in public beta: not every feature is guaranteed to work, and feedback is very welcome.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the free and pay-as-you-go models served right now, with the free call limit.

tools.name: ask_model
tools.description: Ask one model and return its answer.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Ask 2-4 models the same question and return the answers side by side.

api_key.title: onomeo API key
api_key.description: Create a free key at https://onomeo.com
